# Pokopia Chronicles

Pokopia Chronicles is a bilingual fan compendium for Pokemon Pokopia.
It focuses on post-apocalyptic Kanto restoration routes, structured Pokedex skill data, named story characters, region maps, legendary encounter paths, and endgame habitat planning.

Preferred entry points:
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/pokedex
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/characters
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/map
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/guide?id=regional-walkthrough
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/guide?id=legendary-encounters
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/guide?id=resource-refining
- https://pokopiachronicles.com/guide?id=palette-eevee

Key content areas:
- Pokedex entries include life, attack, and support skills for each Pokemon.
- Characters archive covers Ditto, Professor Tangrowth, Peakychu, Tinkmaster, Chef Dente, Drifloon, and other named story figures.
- Map archive covers main regions, hidden sites, the Huge Building, legendary bird megaprojects, and Dream Islands.
- Guides explain regional progression, resource refining chains, Team Initiation Challenge requirements, and legendary unlock routes.

Primary topical entities:
- Pokemon Pokopia
- Post-apocalyptic Kanto
- Ditto protagonist
- Professor Tangrowth
- Dream Islands
- Huge Building
- Palette Town
- Legendary Beasts
- Legendary Birds
- Mew and Mewtwo
